goal: Start an owner-visible Russian terminal UI on the Home computer so Vladislav can watch Kolibri Factory tasks, agents, node health, repair tasks, logs and running state live.
objective: On Home, create or refresh a tmux-based Kolibri Factory wallboard in Russian. It must show Control Plane health, active tasks, child tasks, agent leases, fresh/degraded servers, repair backlog, PR/CI status where available, and logs/status updates. Use existing safe tools if installed. Do not expose secrets. Do not restart production services unless explicitly allowed. If Home direct execution is not possible, prepare a fallback display session through primary-candidate and report exact attach command.
ui_requirements: tmux session name `kolibri-factory-screen` or compatible existing session
Russian labels for overview, nodes, tasks, messages, services, resources and logs
visible active Control Plane tasks and lease owners
fresh working server count and degraded/stale count
acceptance: Remote execution happens on Home or a documented fallback server, not Mac.
Owner gets an exact attach/view command for the live Russian terminal UI.
UI shows live factory task/agent/server status without secrets.
No destructive commands, credential changes or production restarts are performed.
Exact run artifacts are created with status, node, session name, commands and blockers.
